title: The Message in the Bark
text: Words are cut into a tree trunk in your House's tongue, the letters deep and ragged from a knife held in a shaking hand: STILL ALIVE. GOING NORTH. HURRY. The sap has wept over the cuts and hardened amber in the cold.

options.label: Go north, and fast; they asked you to hurry.

outcomes.text: You push north at a hard pace, reading every tree you pass.

options.label: The wisest reads how old the cuts are, to know how much time remains.

outcomes.text: The cuts are three days old. They were bleeding when they made them.

options.label: Cut an answer beneath it so they know you came.

outcomes.text: WE ARE COMING, you carve, in case they come back this way.
